nodes.label: PRODUCTIVITY
nodes.description: Daily haul truck productivity from FMS: cycles, tonnes moved, payload, cycle and queue time, fuel per tonne.

nodes.label: PORT_SCENARIO
nodes.description: Port what-if grid for Q1 FY2027: one row per case and ship-loader outage length (0 to 72 hours, 6-hour steps), with vessels delayed, demurrage, deferred revenue and EBITDA change. IS_ACTUAL marks what really happened.

nodes.label: SPARES_COVER
nodes.description: Daily stock, reorder point, days of cover and status per spare part and plant. IS_LATEST marks today.

nodes.label: COST_PER_TONNE
nodes.description: Monthly C1 cost by cost element with its operational driver and the ore processed that month. ORE_PROCESSED_T repeats on every cost element row of a month.

nodes.label: Site
nodes.description: A mine, processing hub or port. Three sites, each an SAP plant.

nodes.label: Fleet asset
nodes.description: A haul truck, excavator, drill, crusher, conveyor or ship loader.

nodes.label: Maintenance notification
nodes.description: A failure or work request recorded in SAP against an asset.

nodes.label: Material
nodes.description: A spare part or consumable, with criticality A, B or C.

nodes.label: Supplier
nodes.description: A vendor that supplies materials, some as the only source.

nodes.label: Vessel call
nodes.description: One ship loading ore at the port, and the sale billed for it.

nodes.label: Customer
nodes.description: A steel mill that buys the ore.

nodes.label: Cost element
nodes.description: A mining cost category such as diesel, tyres or labour, mapped from G/L accounts.

nodes.label: Fiscal quarter
nodes.description: A quarter of the July-to-June mining fiscal year.

nodes.label: Capital project
nodes.description: A capital project with WBS elements, plan and milestones.

nodes.label: Workforce
nodes.description: People with planned working time and recorded availability.

nodes.label: C1_BRIDGE
nodes.description: C1 cost bridge between consecutive fiscal quarters: one row per lever (volume, diesel efficiency, tyre wear, maintenance, price, other). Levers add up to the change in C1.

nodes.label: SHIPMENTS
nodes.description: Revenue per vessel call: tonnes, price, CFR and FOB revenue, ocean freight, customer, recognition quarter (the quarter loading ends).

nodes.label: DEMURRAGE
nodes.description: Demurrage per vessel call: wait, time at port, laytime, demurrage hours and USD, ship-loader outage hours.

nodes.label: FAILURE_RISK
nodes.description: Daily rule-based failure risk score (0 to 100) per fleet asset from IoT stress, trend, faults and breakdown history. IS_LATEST marks today.

nodes.label: GOLDEN_THREAD
nodes.description: The golden thread: 5 linked records from the VC-0115 ship-loader outage (17 Aug 2026) to the SAP notification, the out-of-stock spare, demurrage and the Q1 FY2027 P&L.

nodes.label: PRODUCTION
nodes.description: Daily mine and plant production: ore and waste mined, strip ratio, Fe grade, ore processed, lump and fines.

nodes.label: BOM_PATH
nodes.description: Supply path from a disrupted part to the port, found with a recursive query over the real SAP bill of material and the fleet register: part, BOM, assembly, fleet class, asset, site, port. One row per node reached.

nodes.label: SITE_PNL
nodes.description: Pilbara Hub P&L per fiscal quarter, one row per line: CFR revenue, ocean freight, FOB revenue, royalties, C1 cash cost, demurrage, EBITDA. Costs are negative.

nodes.label: CERTIFICATES
nodes.description: OEM and quality certificates of alternate suppliers per part, with validity. Simulated.

nodes.label: P2P
nodes.description: Procure to pay per real SAP purchase order line since 2024: invoiced or not, first invoice date, price and quantity variances.

nodes.label: C1_TREND
nodes.description: C1 cash cost per tonne at Pilbara Hub, Mine A, one row per fiscal quarter (GRAIN = QUARTER) and per month (GRAIN = MONTH). Use this table for any C1 per tonne figure.

nodes.label: OPERATING_RATE
nodes.description: Monthly haul-fleet loss tree per autonomy mode: calendar hours split into hauling, queueing, standby, planned maintenance, unplanned down and weather.

nodes.label: DOWNTIME
nodes.description: Daily downtime per fleet asset with lost tonnes and lost revenue, and whether SAP recorded it as a notification.

nodes.label: REVENUE_AT_RISK
nodes.description: Sole suppliers of criticality A parts: the fleet assets that depend on them and the ore tonnes and revenue per day at risk if supply stops.

nodes.label: MAINT_COST
nodes.description: SAP maintenance orders with planned cost (SAP) and actual cost (stand-in), linked to the fleet asset.

nodes.label: ASSET_CARD
nodes.description: One row per fleet asset today: SAP master data and work, IoT risk and telemetry, reliability last quarter, spares and sole suppliers. Each panel has its own provenance.

nodes.label: BUDGET_VS_ACTUAL
nodes.description: Monthly budget vs actual cost by cost centre, process and cost element.

nodes.label: SUPPLIER_QUALITY
nodes.description: Monthly supplier on-time delivery, defect rate, lead time and quality score.

nodes.label: RISK_TIMELINE
nodes.description: For each planted truck failure: daily risk from 16 days before to 3 days after the real SAP notification, and how many days earlier the risk turned HIGH.

nodes.label: WORKFORCE
nodes.description: Monthly workforce readiness per business unit: people, planned hours, confirmed-available hours, unconfirmed hours. Availability status is recorded up to July 2026 only.

nodes.label: CONCENTRATION
nodes.description: Purchase order spend per material and supplier since 2024, with spend share and single-source flags.

nodes.label: PROJECTS
nodes.description: One row per SAP capital project at the 3 sites: plan and actual cost in USD, spend and time elapsed, budget and schedule status, milestones.

nodes.label: ALT_DECISION
nodes.description: Can another supplier replace the closed one? One row per case and alternate supplier with the decision at the standard quality bar of 90: Candidate, Blocked or Review, and the reason. A Review row with no supplier means single source, no alternate.

nodes.label: RELIABILITY
nodes.description: Monthly availability, MTBF, MTTR and breakdowns per fleet asset.

nodes.label: MINE_TO_PORT
nodes.description: Daily flow from pit to ship: ore mined and processed, tonnes railed, port stock, tonnes shipped, vessels waiting at anchor.

nodes.label: DISRUPTION
nodes.description: Supply disruption what-if cases: a supplier plant closes (WHEEL_PLANT: wheel supplier USSU-VSF84, cyclone, 60 days; MOTOR_PLANT: HighTec motor plant, fire, 180 days), with the supplier alert text. Simulated.

nodes.label: MATERIAL_ASSET_USE
nodes.description: Which fleet assets use which spare part.

edges.label: delays (ship loader outage)
edges.join_key: outage window overlaps time at berth
